description: Move stock from one outlet to another — 'send 10 of these from the warehouse to the King Street shop'. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT FIRST, naming both outlets and every quantity: this writes immediately and there is no undo from here. The stock LEAVES the source outlet at once; the destination only gains it when someone confirms arrival with receive_stock_transfer, so until then those units are in transit and count in neither shop. Tell the merchant that. Variant ids come from get_products, outlet ids from get_outlets. Check availability with get_stock first: sending more than the source holds is rejected, and so is sending a variant whose stock is not tracked at the source — there is no count there to move. To correct a count in place (damage, theft, a recount) use adjust_stock instead; to book in a supplier delivery use adjust_stock with STOCK_RECEIVED.

fromOutletId.description: Source outlet id from get_outlets — stock leaves here immediately

invoice.description: Invoice or reference number, if the merchant gave one

items.description: What to move. One entry per variant

quantity.description: Units to send — must not exceed what the source holds

note.description: A note staff will read on the transfer

toOutletId.description: Destination outlet id from get_outlets — must differ from the source
